note: Token budget + cadence guardrails for the Desk Room loop. The daily/hourly tasks and room_queue.py read this. Raising limits raises cost linearly.
_deep_dives_note: Raised 6 -> 14 for the COVERAGE CATCH-UP sprint (2026-07-19), not as a new run rate. ~90 signal-eligible names had never been through the Room; at 6/day that was 15 days. Note the old value was ALREADY incoherent: 6/day x 22k x 30 = 3.96M against a 3M ceiling, i.e. the breaker would have tripped mid-month. Both numbers are now set together. Once catch-up completes this should drop back to ~5 — after first coverage the gate mostly REAFFIRMS (free) and only material change triggers a full debate, so steady-state spend is far below the cap.

circuit_breaker._ceiling_note: Raised 3M -> 6M to cover the one-off catch-up (90 names x ~22k = ~2M) plus normal agent traffic, WITHOUT the breaker tripping mid-sprint. Raising deep_dives_per_day alone would just have hit the wall sooner — the two numbers only mean something together. Revisit down toward 3M once coverage is complete and most days are reaffirms.

spend_ledger.note: room_score / the tasks append actual counts here per run so we can see real vs estimated cost.
